current.notes: Shared shape for tasks 85cc7844 (storage-claude: JSONL lines, contract files) and ff6b9d5b (claude-memory-layer: note files). Rule: load never refuses to start over one bad file or line. storage-claude adds the type, the Snapshot field, the State accessor and the status/health/dashboard surfacing; memory-layer's load_memory pushes into the same Vec via the accumulator instead of returning Err. Rewrites of a log that had bad lines: the bad lines are kept verbatim at their position (LogCursor treats them as opaque items), so a rewrite never silently drops them; storage-claude implements that for notices/decisions. Per-file primitives (contracts, memory) never rewrite a file they failed to parse because ChangedIds only names parsed items.
